# HK Premium-Financing Illustration Calculator

## What this tool is

This tool produces an illustrative Hong Kong premium-financing calculation from user-supplied assumptions. It is **not financial advice, not a quote, and not a product recommendation**. It does not assess suitability or replace a licensed adviser.

## POST /api/simulate

Send JSON with `input` containing every `SimulationInput` field. Optionally include `stress` with `simulatedHibor`, `bondPriceDrop`, `showGuaranteed`, and `sensitivityYear`.

The successful response is `{ output, stress, findings, meta }`. `output` is the engine projection, `stress` is either a stress result or `null`, `findings` is always an advisory array, and `meta` contains `engineVersion` and an ISO UTC `generatedAt` timestamp.

Errors are JSON: `{ "error": "invalid_input", "fields": [{ "field": "...", "reason": "..." }] }`, or `{ "error": "payload_too_large" }`, `{ "error": "method_not_allowed", "allowed": ["POST", "OPTIONS"] }`, or `{ "error": "engine_error" }`.

## Field glossary

- `budget`: total budget, in absolute HKD.
- `cashReserve`: cash retained, in absolute HKD.
- `bondAlloc`: amount allocated to the bond, in absolute HKD.
- `bondYield`: assumed annual bond yield, as a percent.
- `hibor`: current HIBOR assumption, as a percent.
- `cofRate`: cost-of-funds assumption, as a percent.
- `interestBasis`: interest basis, either `hibor` or `cof`.
- `spread`: financing spread above the selected basis, as a percent.
- `leverageLTV`: premium-financing loan-to-value ratio, as a percent.
- `capRate`: maximum financing rate, as a percent.
- `handlingFee`: one-off bond handling fee, as a percent.
- `fundSource`: funding source, either `cash` or `mortgage`.
- `unlockedCash`: cash unlocked by refinancing, in absolute HKD.
- `effectiveMortgageRate`: effective mortgage rate, as a percent.
- `monthlyMortgagePmt`: monthly mortgage payment, in absolute HKD.
- `mortgageTenor`: mortgage term, in whole years.

## MCP endpoint

An MCP server is available at `/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, stateless, no authentication).
It exposes three read-only tools — `run_simulation`, `run_stress_test`, and
`check_assumptions` (which returns the advisory findings alone, without the projection) —
and two resources: `range://accepted` for the accepted input ranges and `doc://about` for
this document. Prefer it over the REST endpoint if your client speaks MCP: the tools carry
typed schemas with units and bounds, so malformed calls are caught before they are sent.

## Accepted ranges

Values outside these ranges are rejected with `400 invalid_input` rather than silently
clamped, so a `200` response always reflects exactly the numbers that were sent.

- Percent fields (`bondYield`, `hibor`, `cofRate`, `spread`, `leverageLTV`, `capRate`, `handlingFee`, `effectiveMortgageRate`): `0` to `100`.
- HKD fields (`budget`, `cashReserve`, `bondAlloc`, `unlockedCash`, `monthlyMortgagePmt`): `0` to `1e15`.
- `mortgageTenor`: whole years, `0` to `50`. A `0` tenor means no mortgage.
- `stress.simulatedHibor` and `stress.bondPriceDrop`: `0` to `100`. `stress.sensitivityYear`: whole years, `1` to `30`.
- When `fundSource` is `mortgage` and `mortgageTenor` is above `0`, `monthlyMortgagePmt` must be above `0`.

## Advisory model

Findings are classified as `blocker`, `warning`, or `note`. Blockers gate PDF export. Warnings and notes provide context for review and do not by themselves make an illustration unsuitable.

All figures are illustrative and depend on assumptions that may not be guaranteed. Actual rates, costs, policy values, returns, financing terms, and outcomes can differ materially.
